declarations.description:
Decorative overlay that sends one or more soft highlights around the border of its containing block. Place it as
a direct child of a positioned container. The component inherits the container radius and uses a border mask, so
the highlight sits on the real border instead of drawing a second, offset outline.
declarations.name: BorderBeam

cssProperties.description: Distance between the beam layer and the container edge.
cssProperties.name: --c2-border-beam--outset

cssProperties.description: Width of the border channel that reveals the beam.
cssProperties.name: --c2-border-beam__beam--width

cssProperties.description: Corner radius of the motion path.
cssProperties.name: --c2-border-beam__beam--radius

cssProperties.description: Glow or other filter applied to each beam.
cssProperties.name: --c2-border-beam__beam--filter

cssProperties.description: Time taken to travel once around the perimeter.
cssProperties.name: --c2-border-beam__beam--duration

cssProperties.description: Delay before animation; a negative value starts partway around.
cssProperties.name: --c2-border-beam__beam--delay

cssProperties.description: Stacking level of the decorative overlay.
cssProperties.name: --c2-border-beam--z-index

members.name: count
members.description: Number of beams distributed evenly around the perimeter.

members.name: side
members.description: Border followed by the beam. `all` loops around the perimeter; one edge moves forward then backward.

members.name: reverse
members.description: Sends the beams around the perimeter in the opposite direction.

members.name: paused
members.description: Freezes the beams at their current positions.
